package shapes;

record Point(int x, int y) {
    int sum() {
        if (x > 0 && y > 0) {
            return x + y;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static Point origin() {
        return new Point(0, 0);
    }
}

class Container {
    void process(int n) {
        class Local {
            int helper(int x) {
                if (x > 0) {
                    return 1;
                }
                return 0;
            }
        }
        Local l = new Local();
        if (n > 0) {
            l.helper(n);
        }
    }
}
